en.headline: Lee says Wang Fuk reforms will follow the inquiry report
en.dek: The Chief Executive said the government would study the independent committee's recommendations as soon as they arrive, then set out reforms and pursue accountability.
body: Chief Executive John Lee said on Tuesday that once the independent committee on the Wang Fuk Court fire in Tai Po submits its report, the government will study the recommendations at once, carry out reforms and publish the details.

Lee, speaking before the Executive Council meeting, said a series of arrangements was already in place. He said that after the fire the government had set up three working groups, covering the investigation and stronger regulation, the coordination of donations and support, and emergency housing plus longer-term rehousing for residents. An independent committee was later appointed to establish what happened, reduce the chance of a repeat, and pursue responsibility.

He said the Policy Address had already announced seven priority reform measures. After the committee reports, he said, the government would move quickly on a fuller set of changes based on the findings, and would hold people to account.
Lee did not give a submission date on Tuesday morning. He also did not name any official who would handle the follow-up.

zh.headline: 李家超：宏福苑報告交到後會盡快改革並追究責任
zh.dek: 特首說獨立委員會提交報告後，政府會即時研究建議、推行改革並公布細節，同時追究責任。
body: 行政長官李家超星期二表示，大埔宏福苑大火獨立委員會提交報告後，政府會即時研究跟進建議，進行改革並公布細節。
他在行政會議前說，大火之後政府已即時成立三個工作小組，分別處理調查和強化規管、統籌募捐和支援，以及應急住宿和長遠安置。其後成立獨立委員會，查明事故、防止再發生，並追究責任。他說這段時間政府已做了一系列部署。
李家超提到，施政報告已宣布七項優先改革措施。獨立委員會交報告後，政府會按報告內容，在短期內盡快推行全面改革，並追究責任。
他星期二早上沒有說出報告的提交日期，也沒有點名負責跟進的官員。
